answerCheck.reason: For falling time t, the sound takes 16t²/1120=t²/70 seconds. Thus t²+70t-539=0=(t-7)(t+77). The positive time is 7 seconds, giving depth 16·7²=784 ft.
Since s=300t, dividing by 300 gives t=s/300.

Let P=k sqrt(t). Then (P+p)^2-P^2=k^2a and (P+q)^2-P^2=k^2b. Eliminating k^2 gives 2P(bp-aq)=aq^2-bp^2, hence the expression in D. Consistent positive pension-increase data with a≠b make the denominator nonzero.
